name: Numerical Weather Prediction GRIB2 Parser Node
description: Parser flow node for numerical-weather-prediction model fields in GRIB2 (NOAA/NCEP GFS and GEFS from NOAA Open Data Dissemination's anonymous public buckets, fetched message by message through the .idx inventory). parse turns each instantaneous field into $WXF record(s) carrying the GRIB2 packing's own integers exactly - value = (R + X 2^E) / 10^D, so SCALE_FACTOR = 2^E / 10^D and ADD_OFFSET = R / 10^D, times 1/100 for a percentage (the fraction $WXF defines) - coded InlineEncodedChunk (delta/zigzag/shuffle), rows south to north and longitude from 0 east, every stride-th point (GEFS 0.5 deg spread at the 1 deg points), whole or in band_rows bands, named as the world-clouds reference names them (wind_east_850hPa, geopotential_height_500hPa, cloud_cover_low, air_temperature_2m, ..._spread). Raw: nothing is resampled or derived (owner 2026-10-02: SDN carries raw feeds; the display derives). GRIB2 is read by the vendored grib2mini (grid 3.0, product 4.0/4.1/4.2, packing 5.0/5.2/5.3, bitmaps), checked against ecCodes on NOAA's own files; interval statistics, other grids or packings, unmapped parameters and integers wider than 16 bits are refused by name. capabilities: none, so the node runs in the browser and on WasmEdge alike.

sequentialJustification.detail: parse is a single-pass transform over the frames the flow hands it: each response's GRIB2 messages are read once and each becomes its record(s). No shared mutable state, no worker pool and no fan-out inside the guest; the fan-out across leads and byte ranges is the flow's, through the http connector node. This guest never spawns a thread, so it compiles the single-thread lane rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.description: Each GRIB job and its HTTP response (paired by position; a response is whole GRIB2 messages of one byte range) -> one $WXF record per field (or per band of band_rows rows) with the packing integers, plus one storage.ingest_with_source meta for the batch. A count mismatch, a non-2xx status, an unreadable message or a field this parser does not publish is refused with a named error, never guessed.

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON GRIB job: url, product, model_key, model_id, model_class, run, lead, stride, band_rows, spread, ensemble_size, attribution.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-range fetch-job attribution (product, model, run, lead, stride, bands, licence and citation) emitted by the nwp-field-source select node inside the same flow; ingest bookkeeping, never persisted as a record.

inputPorts.description: One GRIB job per request frame the select node emitted, in emission order.

acceptedTypeSets.description: hostcap/http-request response, one per job: an aligned-binary $HRB raw-body-v1 frame (status plus the GRIB2 bytes of one range) or the legacy JSON {status,headers,bodyB64} lane.

wildcardJustification.detail: hostcap/http-request response frame ($HRB raw-body-v1, or legacy {status,headers,bodyB64}) consumed inside this flow; its shape is defined by that generic connector, not by SDS.

inputPorts.description: One HTTP response per file job, positionally aligned.

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON storage.ingest_with_source meta for the $WXF batch (schema/provider/source/batch/reconcile/licence/provenance).

wildcardJustification.detail: storage.ingest_with_source meta (schema, provider/source/url/batch attribution, reconcile mode, licence and citation, provenance) consumed by hostcap/storage-ingest inside this flow.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $WXF FlatBuffer record stream, one record per field (or band).
